includes_delisted.rule: true only if every session of the window has a stored all-market capture of BOTH venues (api_endpoint bundle://collector-tw-twse-price-history and bundle://collector-tw-tpex-price-history, dated per-date all-stock pages) and every weekday without a session is recorded closed by an official holiday dataset
includes_delisted.missing_official_dataset: tw_trading_holidays: official TWSE/TPEx holiday schedule (https://www.twse.com.tw/zh/holidaySchedule/holidaySchedule); no such governed dataset is stored, so any real window containing a holiday has an unaccounted weekday and is false. Also unverified: that hosted normalized rows carry meta.venue/api_endpoint as the connector writes them (taiwan_official.py records_from_payload).

includes_suspended.reason: deploy/collector/collector_stack/spiders.py (TWSE ~line 990 and TPEx ~line 1449) drops every all-market row whose close is empty ('if close_price is None: continue'), which is exactly the row of a suspended / non-traded security; no suspended list is stored
includes_suspended.missing_official_dataset: tw_trading_suspension: per-session, per-venue suspended / non-traded security list from the TWSE MI_INDEX all-stock page and the TPEx all-stock daily quotes page (rows without a close), or the exchanges' suspension announcements; the collector must retain them
